errorCard.title: Could not load data
errorCard.supportHint: Need help? Share these details with our support team.

missing.title: No data for this section
missing.description: The server does not expose the matching endpoint yet (feature not deployed), so there is nothing to show.
missing.hint: Data will appear automatically as soon as this feature is ready. You can retry or move to another section.

hint.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your network connection and try again.
hint.timeout: The server took too long to respond. Please try again shortly.
hint.server: The server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few seconds.
hint.auth: Your session has expired or you lack permission. Please sign in again.
hint.default: The system could not complete this request. Please retry — if the issue persists, contact your administrator.
